features.seoDescription: Teams, tributes, memories, awards, and a print-ready online yearbook — see what Yaadbuzz offers before you sign in.

teams.title: Organizations, teams & invites
teams.body: Create an organization, spin up teams, and invite people with a code or email. Everyone lands in one shared space.

tributes.title: Tributes about teammates
tributes.body: Write messages for each other — public, anonymous, or private. Reveal them together when the moment is right.

memories.title: Shared memories
memories.body: Collect moments with photos and comments so the whole team can revisit the year in one place.

awards.title: Topics & awards

yearbook.title: Online yearbook & print

features.ctaBody: Create a free account and begin your team yearbook — or read how Yaadbuzz began.

about.seoDescription: Why Yaadbuzz exists — a college wish to keep shared memories, now an open-source online yearbook for teams.
about.lead: An online yearbook born from a simple college wish: keep the year, together.
about.p1: When I was in college, I wanted something like this — a place where our class could share memories, write about each other, and hold onto the year without it vanishing into chat threads and scattered photos.
about.p2: We had the friendships and the moments. What we did not have was a warm, shared home for them: tributes that could wait for reveal day, memories we all owned, a yearbook we could open online and print when we were ready.
about.p3Before: Yaadbuzz is that home. It is free and open source under the
about.p3License: GNU Affero General Public License v3
about.p3After: , so others can run it, improve it, and keep their own years alive — including when the software is offered as a network service.
about.p4: Near the end of undergrad, a few of us from Sharif’s Faculty of Mathematical Sciences got excited about building the site. We started a Telegram channel and argued about names, features, and everything in between — we even made a Twitter account. The project moved forward for a while, but we never pushed it across the finish line. Now that AI has grown up, I sat down and built the site with AI.
